dashboard.label: Beelzebub — Novel Activity Tracker
dashboard.description: Surfaces attacker IPs, credentials, commands, and HTTP patterns appearing for the first time in the selected window. Uses a NOT subsearch against all prior data to ensure "new" means genuinely first-ever-seen.

search.query: `beelzebub_index` sourcetype="beelzebub:json" msg="New Event" src_ip=* | stats count BY src_ip | search NOT [ search `beelzebub_index` sourcetype="beelzebub:json" msg="New Event" earliest=0 latest=$time_range.earliest$ src_ip=* | stats count BY src_ip | fields src_ip ] | stats count

`beelzebub_index` sourcetype="beelzebub:json" msg="New Event" user=* password=* | stats count BY user, password | search NOT [ search `beelzebub_index` sourcetype="beelzebub:json" msg="New Event" earliest=0 latest=$time_range.earliest$ user=* password=* | stats count BY user, password | fields user, password ] | stats count

`beelzebub_index` sourcetype="beelzebub:json" msg="New Event" command=* NOT command="" | stats count BY command | search NOT [ search `beelzebub_index` sourcetype="beelzebub:json" msg="New Event" earliest=0 latest=$time_range.earliest$ command=* NOT command="" | stats count BY command | fields command ] | stats count

`beelzebub_index` sourcetype="beelzebub:json" msg="Rate limit exceeded" command=* NOT command="" | stats count BY command | search NOT [ search `beelzebub_index` sourcetype="beelzebub:json" msg="Rate limit exceeded" earliest=0 latest=$time_range.earliest$ command=* NOT command="" | stats count BY command | fields command ] | stats count

`beelzebub_index` sourcetype="beelzebub:json" msg="New Event" transport=HTTP uri_path=* | stats count BY uri_path | search NOT [ search `beelzebub_index` sourcetype="beelzebub:json" msg="New Event" earliest=0 latest=$time_range.earliest$ transport=HTTP uri_path=* | stats count BY uri_path | fields uri_path ] | stats count

`beelzebub_index` sourcetype="beelzebub:json" msg="New Event" src_ip=* | stats earliest(_time) AS first_seen, count AS events, values(transport) AS protocols, dc(transport) AS protocol_count BY src_ip | search NOT [ search `beelzebub_index` sourcetype="beelzebub:json" msg="New Event" earliest=0 latest=$time_range.earliest$ src_ip=* | stats count BY src_ip | fields src_ip ] | eval first_seen=strftime(first_seen, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S") | sort -events

`beelzebub_index` sourcetype="beelzebub:json" msg="New Event" user=* password=* | stats earliest(_time) AS first_seen, count AS events, values(src_ip) AS src_ips BY user, password | search NOT [ search `beelzebub_index` sourcetype="beelzebub:json" msg="New Event" earliest=0 latest=$time_range.earliest$ user=* password=* | stats count BY user, password | fields user, password ] | eval first_seen=strftime(first_seen, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S") | sort -events | rename user AS username

`beelzebub_index` sourcetype="beelzebub:json" msg="New Event" (transport=SSH OR transport=TELNET) event.Client=* NOT event.Client="" | stats earliest(_time) AS first_seen, count AS events, values(src_ip) AS src_ips BY event.Client | search NOT [ search `beelzebub_index` sourcetype="beelzebub:json" msg="New Event" earliest=0 latest=$time_range.earliest$ (transport=SSH OR transport=TELNET) event.Client=* NOT event.Client="" | stats count BY event.Client | fields event.Client ] | eval first_seen=strftime(first_seen, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S") | sort -events | rename event.Client AS client

`beelzebub_index` sourcetype="beelzebub:json" msg="New Event" transport=HTTP uri_path=* | stats earliest(_time) AS first_seen, count AS events, values(src_ip) AS src_ips, values(http_user_agent) AS user_agents BY http_method, uri_path | search NOT [ search `beelzebub_index` sourcetype="beelzebub:json" msg="New Event" earliest=0 latest=$time_range.earliest$ transport=HTTP uri_path=* | stats count BY uri_path | fields uri_path ] | eval first_seen=strftime(first_seen, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S") | sort -events | rename http_method AS method, uri_path AS uri

`beelzebub_index` sourcetype="beelzebub:json" msg="New Event" transport=HTTP http_user_agent=* NOT http_user_agent="" | stats earliest(_time) AS first_seen, count AS events, values(src_ip) AS src_ips BY http_user_agent | search NOT [ search `beelzebub_index` sourcetype="beelzebub:json" msg="New Event" earliest=0 latest=$time_range.earliest$ transport=HTTP http_user_agent=* NOT http_user_agent="" | stats count BY http_user_agent | fields http_user_agent ] | eval first_seen=strftime(first_seen, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S") | sort -events | rename http_user_agent AS user_agent

`beelzebub_index` sourcetype="beelzebub:json" msg="New Event" command=* NOT command="" | stats earliest(_time) AS first_seen, count AS events, values(src_ip) AS src_ips, values(event.CommandOutput) AS outputs BY command | search NOT [ search `beelzebub_index` sourcetype="beelzebub:json" msg="New Event" earliest=0 latest=$time_range.earliest$ command=* NOT command="" | stats count BY command | fields command ] | eval first_seen=strftime(first_seen, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S") | sort -events | rename event.CommandOutput AS output

`beelzebub_index` sourcetype="beelzebub:json" msg="Rate limit exceeded" command=* NOT command="" | stats earliest(_time) AS first_seen, count AS events, values(client_ip) AS src_ips BY command | search NOT [ search `beelzebub_index` sourcetype="beelzebub:json" msg="Rate limit exceeded" earliest=0 latest=$time_range.earliest$ command=* NOT command="" | stats count BY command | fields command ] | eval first_seen=strftime(first_seen, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S") | sort -events
